unit: R02 timer and alarm endings refinement

references.title: TIDE — alarm ringing
references.applied: Quiet circular time composition; two plainly named actions with clear visual hierarchy. Tessera separates Done or Stop from Repeat or Snooze without another popup.

references.title: Pillow — alarm ringing
references.applied: A large central cue and explicit snooze duration replace ambiguous zero digits. Tessera retains a direct Stop action rather than a gesture-only dismissal.

references.title: Apple Support — Set timers in Clock on iPhone
references.applied: Repeat starts the same original duration; Stop dismisses the completed timer. Tessera guards both against stale event identifiers.

references.title: Apple Support — Set an alarm in Clock on iPhone
references.applied: Snooze preserves an alarm instead of converting it into an ordinary timer; the daily schedule remains separate from dismissal of today's event.

references.title: Apple Human Interface Guidelines — Motion
references.applied: Motion communicates the completed state through slow orbital light around a fixed semantic mark. No full-field flashes; both labels remain static and readable.
